papers.title_en: FluxDisco: Symbolic Regression for Stoichiometric Dynamical Systems via Monte Carlo Graph Search
papers.authors: Cassandra Durr, Alvaro Köhn-Luque, Chris Jewell, Lloyd A. C. Chapman
papers.evidence: 面向化学计量动力系统的符号回归方法，从噪声数据中发现控制方程。
papers.tldr: 动态符号回归从含噪数据辨识动力学方程，但标准方法常违背物理规律。FluxDisco利用已知化学计量对基于通量的ODE系统进行约束，缩小表达式搜索空间并保证物理一致性。该方法适配蒙特卡洛图搜索以联合发现多个通量项，在物理与生物基准上准确恢复控制方程，实现可解释且物理合法的建模。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical symbolic regression methods identify governing differential equations from noisy data, balancing interpretability and predictive accuracy. However, standard methods often produce expressions that violate known physical laws. To address this, we propose FluxDisco, a physics-informed framework tailored for flux-based, stoichiometric ODE systems. By leveraging a known stoichiometry, we reduce the expression search space and ensure physical adherence. Our framework adapts the Monte Carlo Graph Search algorithm for the unique challenges associated with joint flux discovery of stoichiometric systems. We evaluate our method across a range of physical and biological systems, demonstrating its ability to accurately recover governing dynamics through interpretable equations.

papers.title_en: On a Gradation for Asymptotic Stability
papers.evidence: 直接与逆Lyapunov判据以及稳定度分级，用于动力系统稳定性分析
papers.tldr: 经典渐近稳定性通常只保证状态收敛到平衡点，却并不量化收敛发生的速率，因而难以区分不同类型的衰减行为。该文提出一种渐近稳定性的分级概念：稳定度为零时对应指数稳定，稳定度为正数m时对应按t^{-1/m}规律的代数衰减。作者建立了直接与逆Lyapunov测试，用于判定系统可允许的稳定度，并给出了认证精确稳定度的充分条件；在Hopf、Bautin、分数阶及时变系统的例子中，该方法准确识别出起主导作用的稳定机制。该分级框架为渐近稳定性补充了丰富的定量信息，并为非线性系统的收敛速率分析与控制设计提供了新视角。
papers.abstract_en: Classical asymptotic stability guarantees convergence but does not quantify the rate at which convergence occurs. This paper introduces a gradation of asymptotic stability where degree zero corresponds to exponential stability and degree $m>0$ corresponds to algebraic decay of order $t^{-1/m}$. We provide direct and converse Lyapunov tests for admissible degrees and conditions for certifying the exact stability degree. Hopf, Bautin, fractional-degree, and time-varying examples demonstrate how the degree identifies the leading stabilizing mechanism.

papers.title_en: Data-Driven Learning of Unknown Nonlinear Differential Equations Using Functional Analysis
papers.authors: Seyyed Shaho Alaviani, Yongzhi Qu, Gregory W. Vogl
papers.evidence: 从轨迹数据驱动发现未知非线性微分方程，与面向动力系统的符号回归和方程发现目标内在一致
papers.tldr: 针对缺乏物理先验时仅由一条状态轨迹学习非线性常微分方程未知向量场的问题，提出一种基于泛函分析与算子理论的可解释机器学习方法。其核心在于将代价函数构造为函数空间中两个函数间的积分距离，替代传统离散误差求和，并设计了增量学习算法以便在线处理新增训练样本。该方法适用于受外力与无外力、自治与非自治动力系统，能够同时辨识未知外力和底层动力学。数值算例验证了方法的有效性与优越性。
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, the problem of data-driven discovery of nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs) is recast, and a new interpretable machine learning (ML) method is proposed. The proposed method aims to learn the unknown vector field of nonlinear dynamics without prior knowledge of the system's physics from only one single state trajectory's data. The proposed method has two fundamental differences with existing methods: 1) the formulation presented in this method is derived based on Functional Analysis and Operator Theory, and 2) the cost function is constructed in the function space as a distance between two functions as an integral, instead of the discrete-sum of errors used in existing ML approaches. An incremental learning algorithm is proposed to learn the unknown vector field to handle new training samples in an online manner. The proposed method can discover the unknown vector field from both forced and unforced autonomous and non-autonomous (or time-varying) dynamical systems. The proposed method is able to simultaneously discover unknown external forces as a function of time and unknown underlying dynamics. Finally, numerical examples are given to demonstrate the advantages of the proposed method.
